scene_state_transition_model.statement: The current catalog identity is spellweavers-run / Spellweaver's Run, with the recorded cover, while the card is normalized to no href and coming-soon; the retained E2E source intends navigation, Begin the Run, and canvas visibility but is not a successful browser observation.

The historical model defines start, playing, victory, and defeat statuses and stores difficulty, mana, score, combo, collected words, target index, orbs, current sentence, words, answer counters, completed sentences, game time, and spawn timer.
Historical difficulty configuration pairs easy, normal, hard, and extreme with scroll speeds 60, 90, 120, and 150 pixels per second and spawn intervals 2000, 1500, 1000, and 500 milliseconds.
Historical lane assignment selects left below 0.33, center below 0.66, and right otherwise; an orb is created for a sentence word in one lane at half the configured scrollHeight.

Each historical tick advances every orb by scrollSpeed/1000 multiplied by deltaMs, removes orbs beyond GAME_HEIGHT plus collectionZoneHeight, and when the spawn timer reaches the difficulty interval spawns the first word index not represented by an orb and resets the timer.
Historical collection searches the selected lane for the first uncollected orb whose y is in the collection zone from GAME_HEIGHT minus collectionZoneHeight through GAME_HEIGHT.
A correct historical collection removes the orb, appends its word, advances target index and combo, increments score and counters, and changes status to victory after the last word.
An incorrect historical collection removes the orb, subtracts 20 configured mana without going below zero, resets combo, increments attempts, and defeats at zero mana.

Entering historical playing requests fullscreen, runs requestAnimationFrame, clamps frame delta to 50 milliseconds, and ticks game state; historical victory or defeat computes accuracy and XP, stores results, and changes the component phase to ended.
The historical end screen selects victory or defeat text, reports score, XP, accuracy and custom counts, restarts to start, and exits to /student/games.

The historical logical surface is 390 by 600 with three lanes, an 80-pixel collection zone, and a 60-pixel scroll header; the renderer draws three equal lane rectangles below the scroll and above the collection zone and draws the collection zone from y 520 through y 600 across 390 pixels.

Historical projection uses measured container dimensions and a child Group with uniform logical scale on a 390-by-600 background anchored at zero,zero; no camera-follow transform is established by the cited projection.

Historical responsive measurement uses ResizeObserver and polls dimensions every 200 milliseconds for at most two seconds; scale is the smaller of container width divided by 390 and container height divided by 600.

The historical container uses height 75vh and full width, switches at md to aspect-video and automatic height, active play retains minHeight 400px, and the active container binds click plus touchstart.

Historical pointer or touch input converts clientX to logical gameX, divides by lane width, clamps lane index to zero through two, and invokes that lane; keyboard input maps ArrowLeft/A to left, ArrowDown/S to center, and ArrowRight/D to right while playing.

The historical renderer clips orb groups to the lane and collection region and renders each orb with Circle and Text primitives; its HUD renders a mana bar, Mana text, Score text, and Combo text within the logical surface.

The withdrawn historical cartridge declares semantic slots for the world background, hero, correct and incorrect targets and feedback, UI panel, lane marker, word orb, collection zone, and mana effect; its fixed Phaser configuration is 960 by 540 and its background uses world.background when present or a full-surface rectangle otherwise.

The withdrawn historical cartridge maps the lower 75 percent of normalized pointer space into three equal horizontal input regions and positions its active orb at x 160 plus lane times 320 and y equal to model.orb.position.
The withdrawn historical cartridge resolves input only after confirming a nonzero canvas surface and advances movement by delta multiplied by edition speed tuning.

A withdrawn-cartridge missed crossing subtracts 10 mana, resets combo, subtracts 10 score, increments attempts, respawns the same target, and defeats at zero mana; its collection gate ignores lanes outside integer zero through two and positions before 380 or after 450.

A correct lane in the withdrawn cartridge increments combo and answers, adds 100 plus prior combo times 25 score, advances the word, advances sentences in order, and finishes victory after all sentences.

mechanics_learning_model.statement: The historical interaction presents sentence words as lane-selected falling orbs, with lane selection and collection-zone timing determining the collection attempt.

Correct collection historically appends the collected word, advances the target, combo, score, and counters, and can complete the word sequence; incorrect collection historically consumes mana, resets combo, increments attempts, and can defeat.

The withdrawn cartridge preserves a second historical progression shape in which correct lanes advance words and sentences and calculate combo-based score, while missed crossings apply mana, combo, score, attempt, and respawn outcomes.
Historical state and terminal reporting include words, sentences, answers, accuracy, score, XP, completion, mana, combo, and attempts in the cited model and transition records.

Historical keyboard and pointer/touch controls provide left, center, and right lane selection while playing, with the withdrawn cartridge additionally declaring normalized pointer regions and a collect action region.
The historical HUD exposes mana, score, and combo during active play, while terminal presentation exposes victory or defeat, score, XP, accuracy, and custom counts.
